Machine learning

Machine learning is a field of study in artificial intelligence concerned with the development and study of statistical algorithms that can learn from data and generalize to unseen, out-of-distribution data samples.

Learning algorithms build a model based on sample training data, which is then used to make predictions or decisions without being explicitly programmed to perform the task in question.

Supervised learning trains models on labelled examples, whereas unsupervised learning finds structure in unlabelled data without an explicit target variable, such as clustering and dimensionality reduction.
